evidence_cards.content: There is a requirement to distinguish between live tracks that are involved in an exercise and other live tracks being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the high-level objective of the use case: distinguishing specific track types (exercise vs. non-exercise) for identity classification.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the primary objective (goal) of the use case: to prevent automatic correlation under specific restrictive conditions. It directly addresses what the system aims to achieve regarding track management.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific objective of managing track identity classification by allowing automatic acceptance of identity changes under defined conditions.

evidence_cards.content: When a C² JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, that JU shall initiate action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the specific high-level objective (goal) of the primary actor (C² JU): to resolve dual designations when they are recognized. It directly answers 'what the primary actor wants to achieve' in this context.
